# Part III: One Analysis, Many Publications {.unnumbered .part}

Which kinds of municipality exist in Colombia, judged by the safety of their drinking water,
their services and their context? And how do infant mortality, exam scores and school dropout
differ between those kinds? Part III answers both questions with real public data, then
publishes the answer as a report, slides, a blog post and a website, all reading the results
of one analysis script.

The unit of analysis is one municipality's urban or rural zone in one year, so a
municipality's two zones can belong to different kinds, and a zone can move between kinds
over the years. The project lives beside the London one:

```text
~                      your home folder
├── quarto-workshop/   the clone from Chapter 3
├── london-guide/      Part II
└── water-quality/     this part's project
```
